name: @chirp/proto
description: Package shim for the committed ts-proto output. Not an npm workspace member: npm/CI consumers resolve @chirp/proto via bundler aliases (apps/desktop vite.config.ts, apps/web_companion) and tsconfig paths (apps/shared/protocol). This file exists so the HarmonyOS app (apps/harmony) can depend on the same directory through ohpm file: resolution without forking the gencode. Regenerate via gen_proto.sh; never edit by hand.
